verdict.rationale: Dover documents only basic single-interview scheduling: candidate booking links, manually placing a meeting with Schedule Interview, or direct calendar booking with full permissions. The pack has no evidence of automatic scheduling for multi-interviewer panels or onsite loops, interviewer load balancing, room booking, or conflict resolution, so the basic scheduling counts only as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a recruiter, multi-interviewer panels and full onsite loops schedule automatically — interviewer load balancing, room booking, and conflict resolution included
